import numpy as np

def compute_new_pattern():
    # Test input
    origins = [(2,1,1), (6,7,2), (7,5,6), (7,9,3)]
    ro, co = 11, 11
    
    all_rows = [o[0] for o in origins]
    all_cols = [o[1] for o in origins]
    min_r, max_r = min(all_rows), max(all_rows)
    min_c, max_c = min(all_cols), max(all_cols)
    
    print(f"bbox: rows [{min_r}, {max_r}], cols [{min_c}, {max_c}]")
    print(f"min_r={min_r}, max_r={max_r}, min_c={min_c}, max_c={max_c}")
    
    spawns = {}
    
    for r, c, v in origins:
        is_min_r = r == min_r
        is_max_r = r == max_r
        
        if is_max_r and is_min_r:
            continue
        
        spawn_r = min_r + v
        c1 = max(0, min_c - v)
        c2 = c
        
        if 0 <= spawn_r < ro and 0 <= c1 < co:
            spawns[(spawn_r, c1)] = v
        if 0 <= spawn_r < ro and 0 <= c2 < co:
            spawns[(spawn_r, c2)] = v
    
    print(f"Spawns: {spawns}")
    
    # All feature points
    all_pts = list(spawns.keys()) + [(r,c) for r,c,v in origins]
    min_f_r = min(p[0] for p in all_pts)
    max_f_r = max(p[0] for p in all_pts)
    min_f_c = min(p[1] for p in all_pts)
    max_f_c = max(p[1] for p in all_pts)
    
    print(f"Feature bbox: rows [{min_f_r}, {max_f_r}], cols [{min_f_c}, {max_f_c}]")
    
    # Build result
    result = np.zeros((ro, co), dtype=int)
    for r, c, v in origins:
        result[r, c] = v
    for (r, c), v in spawns.items():
        result[r, c] = v
    
    # Fill with 5s (not 1s!), except maybe preserve min value somewhere
    for r in range(min_f_r, max_f_r+1):
        for c in range(min_f_c, max_f_c+1):
            if result[r, c] == 0:
                result[r, c] = 5
    
    print("Result with 0 background, 5 fill:")
    for row in result:
        print(row)
    
    return result
